title: Toddler Girl in Ruffled Dress at 3rd Birthday, 1950s Living Room Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century domestic snapshot featuring a young girl celebrating her third birthday in the family living room. Kneeling on the carpet in a frilly, tiered crinoline party dress and Mary Jane shoes, she glances back over her shoulder wearing a tall paper birthday crown decorated with the number '3'. Scattered on the carpet around her are birthday gifts including miniature dollhouse furniture (a wooden crib and high chair with a small doll) and a play baking set with tiny bundt and fluted cake molds.
